$comment: Exceptions to scripts/check-assets.mjs. Key: path from the repo root. reason: why this file may exceed its budget, written for a reviewer. maxBytes: the size as reviewed; the file fails again if it grows past it. Prune entries the check reports as missing or within budget.

public/file-uploads/foodCarousel.png.reason: 3240x2700 six-dish photo collage, already re-encoded losslessly by optimize-assets. A palette (lossy) PNG or a downscale to about 1920 px would bring it near 1.5 MB; that is a quality decision for the content owner, deferred. The path is in seeds and the live DB, so it must stay a PNG under this name.
